jobs.description:
Shape the future of audit methodology and technology

Ready to combine your audit expertise with innovation and methodology? Perfect timing! We’re looking for a Technical Specialist – Audit & Assurance Technology & Standards.

If you enjoy translating complex audit standards into practical tools, improving the way auditors work, and collaborating on technology-driven improvements within audit, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a real impact.

You’ll act as the operational link between our Audit & Assurance Tech & Innovation Committee and the Technical (A&A Compliance) team, ensuring that new technologies, evolving standards and audit methodology move forward together.
What will you be doing?
Forget static methodologies that gather dust. You keep our audit approach sharp, practical and future-proof.

• Translate evolving standards into practice – Monitor new audit standards, regulatory updates and guidance from the BDO network. You analyse the impact and convert these developments into concrete updates for methodology, templates and guidance used by our audit teams.
• Develop practitioner-friendly tools – Revise and maintain audit templates, checklists and guidance. You ensure they remain compliant, user-friendly and efficient, striking the right balance between innovation, quality and practicality.
• Bridge innovation and compliance – Work closely with the Innovation Officer within Audit & Assurance to assess new audit tools and technologies. You provide compliance input, methodology requirements and risk assessments to ensure new solutions truly support the audit process.
• Contribute to audit technology initiatives – Collaborate with internal teams, international member firms and external partners (such as startups or solution providers) to explore new technologies that can strengthen the audit practice.
• Support pilots and implementations – Analyse the impact of new tools or methodology updates, help coordinate pilot projects and identify training or change management needs for our audit teams.
• Communicate changes clearly – Produce concise guidance, change logs and practitioner updates whenever templates, processes or standards evolve.
• Ensure consistency across technical initiatives – Work closely with other technical specialists to maintain alignment and quality across the different components of our audit methodology.
What do you bring to the table?
Your foundation:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in audit (Big Four, national firm or similar environment)
• Strong interest in audit standards, methodology and compliance
• Affinity with technology and experience with digital audit tools or data analytics
• Advanced Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, Power Query / Power Pivot; basic VBA is a plus)
• Experience with SharePoint or similar document management systems
• Experience developing templates, guidance documents or policy updates
• Professional qualification such as CPA, CA or CIA is a plus but not required
• Fluency in English; Dutch or French is an asset
 

Your personality:

• You enjoy translating complex technical requirements into clear, practical solutions
• You combine a strong compliance mindset with curiosity for new technologies
• You are structured and detail-oriented, with strong version control and documentation discipline
• You work independently and proactively, while collaborating smoothly with colleagues across teams
• You are comfortable managing multiple small projects simultaneously
• You’re motivated to collaborate internationally with other BDO member firms and contribute to shared initiatives

Responsibilities

• Serve as the technical lead for the product lifecycle, taking ownership of all technical aspects of both custom and off-the-shelf solutions.
• Translate complex business requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications while challenging existing workflows.
• Lead the implementation and configuration of geospatial products and integrated custom components.
• Oversee the build and deployment of solutions based on modern cloud and backend technologies.
• Coordinate with internal platforms and external suppliers to ensure adherence to security and technology standards.
• Perform technical evaluations and fit-gap analyses during software selection and procurement processes.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in GIS solution design and operation within the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem, including Enterprise, Online, Pro, and APIs/SDKs.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in solution architecture, including functional design, data modelling, and fit-gap analysis.
• You possess extensive experience with geospatial data-integration tools such as Safe Software FME for spatial data transformation and automation.
• You have experience developing and integrating components using Microsoft technologies like .NET and SQL Server.
• You possess hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• You bring a solid understanding of IT service management processes, security standards, and compliance requirements.
• You're a holder of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or an equivalent field.
• You're proactive, autonomous, and comfortable managing multidisciplinary stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch and/or French with a strong command of English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Vertigis Studio or Vertigis Integrator.
• Knowledge of the electricity or energy sector.

Our client is a dynamic and growing company in the region of Oostende.

jobs.description:
Your mission: WIN NEW BUSINESS!      You will take ownership of new client acquisition in the European (bio)pharmaceutical market.    Your primary goal is to build a strong pipeline, engage decisionmakers and win new contracts for our    QC laboratory services.    You combine disciplined prospecting with consultative selling and confidently drive opportunities from first contact through negotiation and contract signature.
   
• Identify, target and acquire new customers in the European (bio)pharmaceutical sector, with a focus on companies developing and manufacturing small and/or large molecules.  
• Build and execute a proactive account acquisition plan, including cold outreach, networking, referrals, industry events and strategic partnerships.  
• Create and maintain a healthy, qualified sales pipeline and take full ownership of opportunities from lead generation to closing.  
• Lead negotiations, overcome objections and close profitable contracts in line with commercial targets.  
• Represent SGS Pharma laboratory services at conventions, exhibitions, professional associations and targeted networking events.  
• Maintain accurate CRM data, opportunity stages, next actions and forecasts. 

What do you need to be successful in this role?
   
• A bachelor's or master's degree in pharmaceutical sciences, life sciences or a related field.  
• At least 3 years of successful sales or business development experience in the pharmaceutical industry, ideally within laboratory, analytical, QC, CDMO/CRO or related services.  
• Good knowledge of regulatory QC requirements, including GMP and FDA expectations.  
• Consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills, combined with a strong focus on measurable commercial results.  
• You stay focused through long sales cycles and do not wait for opportunities to come to you.  
• An entrepreneurial and structured working style, with strong CRM discipline  
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.    Additional European languages are an advantage.  
This is a position for someone who wants to have a real impact on business growth.    You will have the freedom to develop new markets and customers while being backed by experienced experts.
 
You can focus on building relationships, identifying opportunities and closing businesses, while working in a scientific environment where quality, expertise and reliability are key.

Your mandate: execution, ownership and results 
You will personally lead the on-site execution of a major industrial project while overseeing several others, with individual projects worth several million euros. Your responsibility extends from site mobilisation and execution through handover and contractual and financial close-out.
 
This is neither a design-engineering position nor a remote project oversight role. You will be close to the work, teams, subcontractors and customers — while maintaining control of safety, quality, deadlines, budgets, margins and contractual commitments.
 Where you will make the difference  
• Deliver on site. Set execution priorities, coordinate multidisciplinary teams and subcontractors, resolve operational issues and ensure safe, high-quality delivery. 
• Protect project performance. Own budgets, forecasts, costs, cash flow and margins; spot deviations early and act before they affect results. 
• Manage contractual complexity. Anticipate risks, handle variations and claims, contribute to negotiations and safeguard customer relationships, including in public-sector projects. 
• Lead and develop people. Guide a team of approximately five to six project professionals, building accountability, confidence and stronger project practices. 
• Create clarity. Use practical planning, reporting and project reviews to turn complex situations into timely decisions — without unnecessary bureaucracy. 
 
• At least 7 years managing complex industrial projects, including substantial, hands-on responsibility for on-site execution. 
• At least 3 years in project management roles, with proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams. 
• Strong financial and contractual judgement: budgets, margins, forecasts, risk, negotiation and claims. 
• A sound technical foundation, ideally in mechanical, electromechanical, civil or industrial engineering; other educational backgrounds are welcome with substantial relevant experience. 
•  Fluent French and English; basic Dutch is an advantage. Experience with public procurement is particularly valuable.  
Above all, you enjoy the reality of industrial sites. You are pragmatic, structured and decisive; you can challenge technical choices, understand their commercial consequences and bring people with you.

jobs.occupation: ESG & Impact Officer - International Exposure - Brussels
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a medium-sized organization within the financial services sector, specializing in banking and financial services. It is known for its focus on innovation, sustainability, and delivering impactful solutions for its stakeholders

Jobomschrijving

As an ESG & Impact Officer your responsibilities are:

• Conduct ESG and impact due diligence for high-risk investments
• Assess projects across sectors such as infrastructure, mining, agriculture, forestry, and financial services
• Manage external ESG and environmental & social consultants
• Support portfolio companies in implementing ESG management systems and action plans
• Monitor ESG performance and impact outcomes throughout the investment lifecycle
• Strengthen ESG policies, frameworks, tools, and internal processes
• Contribute to impact reporting, case studies, and stakeholder communications
• Coordinate third-party ESG and impact assessments
• Represent the organization at industry events and ESG-related initiatives

A successful ESG & Impact Officer should have:

• Master's degree in Economics, International Development, Political Science, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline
• Strong experience applying IFC Performance Standards
• Direct contacts with companies
• Exposure to projects in emerging and developing markets
• Solid knowledge of ESG risk assessment methodologies
• Experience reviewing Environmental & Social Management Systems (ESMS)
• Understanding of impact measurement frameworks, SDGs, Theory of Change, or similar approaches
• Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; Power BI experience is a plus
• Ability to draft high-quality analytical reports and investment documentation in English

jobs.occupation: Finance Officer – Financial Control, Reporting & Process Improvement
jobs.description:
As a Finance Officer, you join the Administration Division of an international intergovernmental organisation promoting free trade and economic integration. You take hands-on responsibility for financial control and reporting while leading initiatives to improve administrative and financial processes.
 

You report directly to the Head of Finance and work within a four-person finance team. The department manages the organisation’s finances across offices in Brussels, Luxembourg and Geneva, as well as its Financial Mechanism Office.
 

This position is exclusively open to nationals of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. The starting date is as soon as possible and no later than 1 March 2027. The application deadline is 18 October 2026.
 

Je verantwoordelijkheden:
 
 

• Preparing financial reports and analyses. 

• Performing accounting controls. 

• Coordinating the year-end closing process. 

• Managing projects to improve business processes within the Administration Division. 

• Overseeing procurement activities. 

• Overseeing contract management. 

• Overseeing travel management. 

• Acting as Head of Finance when required. 
 

• Nationality of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway or Switzerland is an essential eligibility requirement. 

• A master’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting or another relevant field is required. 

• At least five years of relevant experience in financial management, accounting, controlling, audit and/or consulting provides the necessary professional foundation. 

• A solid understanding of accounting, controlling and reporting is essential. 

• Practical experience with at least one accounting software package is required. 

• Excellent command of MS Excel supports your daily work. 

• Fluency in written and spoken English is essential. 

• A structured and analytical mindset characterises your approach. 

• Strong interpersonal skills allow you to collaborate effectively with colleagues. 

• You demonstrate commitment, motivation and initiative. 

• At least two years of consulting experience is an advantage. 

• Experience with payroll and public procurement would be an asset. 

• Knowledge of MS Dynamics 365 Finance and Power BI, including Power Query and Power Pivot, offers added value. 

• Experience as an IT systems superuser and/or with systems implementation is an advantage. 

• Project management experience and the ability to lead business improvement processes are valuable. 

• Previous work in an international environment is a plus. 

• Self-reliance, autonomy and a proactive approach complete your profile.
